Subject: sudden 503s and timeouts between 07:20-07:43 UTC — requesting SLA review

Hi Kimberly / Karthik,

This morning at ~07:20–07:43 UTC we saw a sharp spike of 503s and elevated tail latency across checkout endpoints that use Redwood for embeddings+generation. Traffic graphs and retries caused a visible outage for a subset of customers and several payments failed to process.

We’ve pulled request logs for the timeframe and attached a small sample to this message (ops@paybright.com is looped for logs). Can you confirm whether this meets Redwood’s definition of an availability incident eligible for SLA credit? We need to understand eligibility and next steps — our finance team is asking for an initial estimate for credits while we await any RCAs.

Thanks,
Elena

Quick triage notes (preliminary):
- Ingress telemetry shows an amplification of 5xx responses starting 07:19:52 UTC with a concentrated cluster on two serving pools in us-east-1.
- Error rates returned to baseline by 07:44:10 UTC after routing changes and a restart of one node group.
- We see 1.7% of requests in that window returned 503s for the PayBright tenant key; retries caused ~0.9% additional latency spikes. Total impacted request count (sampled) ~ 2.4k over the 24m window.

Attached: initial_timeline.csv (sampling of events + node IDs). I’m marking this as a potential availability incident that likely meets the SLA degradation threshold, but we need full raw traces and authz routing logs to confirm scope.

Next steps:
- Marcus to pull full raw traces + KV/cache hit rates for the tenant;
- We will compute exact eligible downtime per the contract and propose a provisional credit if eligible.

—Dylan

Elena — appreciate the bundle and the note on double-charges. Our SREs have completed the first-pass impact calculation and we’re confident the event meets the availability SLA criteria for partial remedial credit.

What I can confirm now: 1) provisional eligible window we are using: 07:19:52–07:44:10 UTC (24m 18s) for PayBright tenant key; 2) sampled affected requests ~2.4k; 3) provisional credit: we typically calculate credit per the contract (monthly uptime % bands) — to speed things up I’ve included a temporary credit proposal in the attached PDF that covers the impacted window while we finalize exact token/request accounting.

Next steps and ownership: 
- Marcus (SRE) will upload the full evidence bundle and a detailed timeline to the shared Drive link (see above) by EOD today.
- Laura (Legal) will prepare the official SLA credit memo and any contract references needed for your finance team.
- We will deliver a full RCA within 5 business days and an updated credit calculation after trace-level reconciliation.

If PayBright agrees to the provisional credit approach, we can issue a credit memo that you can apply against the next billing cycle immediately. Let me know if you prefer a one-time payment instead — we’ll coordinate with finance.

Apologies for the impact — we’ll prioritize the RCA and corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
